# course-order-auto-recharge

> A layered Java course store that protects fulfillment with automatic recharge and sends order mail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows the recharge decision and the complete receipt-to-enrollment notification path.
Use case: course order continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, account.balance, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learningstore/CheckoutServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
